description: Dart is a language used for apps and tools. Flutter uses Dart to build screens. These 12 starter lessons use small examples and simple words. Read the result, make one small change, and try the practice question. Install Dart 3 or later. Save one example as lesson.dart and run dart run lesson.dart. Flutter is not needed for these language lessons.
whatYouWillLearn: Build a text message with Dart
